subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the Google Chat plugin add first-class all-message Space ingestion now, and if so should the accepted design use user OAuth, Google Workspace Events/Pub/Sub subscriptions, or a narrower service-account-only scope?
rationale: The remaining request is not a mechanical adapter bug: it adds credential scope, event subscription, secret storage, setup, and security expectations for a bundled channel plugin.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth/events design
options.body: Implement the capability inside the Google Chat plugin with explicit SecretRef/redaction, scoped auth, Pub/Sub or OAuth event routing, docs, and live proof before enabling it.

options.title: Keep service-account HTTP webhooks only
options.body: Leave Google Chat as mention-gated service-account webhook support and document all-message Space ingestion as unsupported for now.

options.title: Defer to an external plugin proposal
options.body: Ask for a separate plugin or design proposal if maintainers do not want the bundled plugin to own the new credential and event surface yet.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth/events design
recommendation.body: Implement the capability inside the Google Chat plugin with explicit SecretRef/redaction, scoped auth, Pub/Sub or OAuth event routing, docs, and live proof before enabling it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent review and commit history across the Google Chat auth/thread/docs surface and is the best available owner for the security/product choice.
